bootloaders.bios: Hybrid El Torito MBR / Isolinux + GRUB 2 (cdboot.img)

critical_fixes_incorporated.issue: Kernel panic - not syncing: Attempted to kill init! exitcode=0x00000200 on physical Lenovo IdeaPad + JMicron external drive
critical_fixes_incorporated.root_cause: The initramfs medium locator had hardcoded block devices (/dev/sr0, /dev/sda1, /dev/sdb1), strictly attempted 'mount -t iso9660', and lacked fat.ko/vfat.ko/nls_*.ko kernel modules. Partition E: on physical Disk 1 is partition 2 (/dev/sda2) formatted FAT32.
critical_fixes_incorporated.resolution: Extracted and bundled fat.ko, vfat.ko, exfat.ko, nls_cp437.ko, nls_ascii.ko, nls_iso8859-1.ko, and nls_utf8.ko into early uncompressed CPIO initramfs; rewrote scripts/live mountroot() with dynamic device iteration (/dev/sr*, /dev/sd*, /dev/nvme*, /dev/vd*), multi-filesystem probing (iso9660, vfat, ext4, exfat), findiso loopback and auto ISO discovery, and POSIX shell constructs.

critical_fixes_incorporated.issue: Overlayfs lowerdir mount failure on FAT32 volumes
critical_fixes_incorporated.resolution: Fixed overlay injection fallback in scripts/live to copy directly from /run/live/medium/monodesk/rootfs_overlay without failing on an invalid iso9660 remount of FAT32 block devices.

critical_fixes_incorporated.issue: Busybox syntax incompatibility in early userspace
critical_fixes_incorporated.resolution: Replaced non-existent 'seq' command with POSIX shell for loops and native shell globbing.
